### A Narrow Gate; a Hard Way
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/narrow-gate-hard-way
Passage: Matthew 7:13-14
Points:
- Jesus calls His listeners to a decisive choice at the end of the Sermon on the Mount.
- Discipleship allows only two paths: wholehearted commitment to Christ or the way to ruin.
- Choosing and walking the true path is possible only through divine grace.
- Believers must rely on God daily to endure trials and resist apostasy.
- Following Jesus means surrendering personal agendas in exchange for His kingdom ethic.

### What Does it Mean That the Gate Is Narrow in Matthew 7?
Author: Meg Bucher
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-does-it-mean-that-the-gate-is-narrow.html
Passage: Matthew 7:13-14
Points:
- Entering the narrow gate requires deliberate faith in Christ rather than drifting with culture.
- Salvation cannot be earned through human effort; it is received as God's gift.
- Discipleship involves daily submission of personal pride to God's will.
- Living out the narrow way requires the power and guidance of the Holy Spirit.
- Choosing the narrow path brings persecution, yet it guarantees eternal life and joy.
